callReturnDisposal.trace: ShareInput owns its stored text and returns fresh views. ShareValues/ShareSet getters return snapshots; restore/combine transfer ShareSet owners. restoreShareSet/combineSskrShareSet compatibility wrappers use using then return plain RepairedSet; callers of those wrappers do not acquire the internal owner. ShareInput.restoreComplete scopes its internal ShareSet and guards after await. checkedExport transfers ShareExport on every outcome; current CLI/ShareRestore consumers scope written. JointPlan creators own the plan until searchOnce/finally ends it; terminal search routines borrow a live plan. Internal repair math is outside this caller admission.

BackupReading stores only record metadata plus an owned text buffer. codes/marked-codes factories return independent EncodedBackup/MissingCodes children. Current input/backup question callers keep reading and provisional children live across awaited mode/format questions, transfer accepted children and wipe cancelled/refused children. EncodedBackup itself defines wipe/Symbol.dispose; Redacted supplies only redaction. Already returned arrays/strings are snapshots rather than references whose later disposal changes old value expectations.

CardTemplate portable methods receive borrowed CardDrawing/CardContent and return fresh Uint8Array or SheetShape metadata. Shapers/decoys/content validators operate on plain projections, not SecretValue. Node publication adapters wipe output bytes after await. ShareCardSet.create temporarily scopes Share readers but retains content strings/arrays; forIndividualCards retains a separate plan. EncodeCardExport caches its outcome/job. Neither retaining class has wipe/dispose: these are the original SEC001 variants. Public preview and renderer self-tests use only fixed synthetic data.

CLI creating consumers scope searches/accepted results across asynchronous uses.

ShareInput owns its stored text and returns fresh views. ShareValues/ShareSet getters return snapshots; restore/combine transfer ShareSet owners. restoreShareSet/combineSskrShareSet compatibility wrappers use using then return plain RepairedSet; callers of those wrappers do not acquire the internal owner. ShareInput.restoreComplete scopes its internal ShareSet and guards after await. checkedExport transfers ShareExport on every outcome; current CLI/ShareRestore consumers scope written. JointPlan creators own the plan until searchOnce/finally ends it; terminal search routines borrow a live plan. Internal repair math is outside this caller admission.

export type CommandEnd = Cancelled | undefined;

/**
 * What runs each command, with its options; a command without one does not compile. A command that
 * asks nothing returns nothing.
 */

  Record<CommandName, (args: ParsedArguments) => void | Promise<void> | Promise<CommandEnd>>
> = {
  encode: runEncode,
  decode: runDecode,
  "re-encode": runReEncode,
  "recover-date": runRecoverDate,
  "recover-word": runRecoverWord,
  "sskr-split": (args) => runSskrSplit(args),
  "sskr-combine": (args) => runSskrCombine(args),
  "sskr-export": runSskrExport,
  preview: runPreview,
  table: runTable,
  "self-test": () => runSelfTest(),
};

protocol.execution: Static reviewer assessment; retained executions separately named.

interface.assessment: Long shared option/context shapes inspected as host orchestration; retained card plans merit ownership fix, not speculative generic abstraction. No smell treated automatically as defect.

coreRuleLedger.coordinator: Primary source/consumer trace applies; coordinator checks docs/build/history contracts at per-file stated depth.
coreRuleLedger.qualification: Review disposition is not universal conformance or new runtime proof.

coreRuleLedger.title: Independent review after a fix

protocol.evidence: This reviewer did not implement current fixes, launched no children or chats, obeyed 128MiB helper cap/3GiB reserve. Exact frozen hashes checked; prior R24/native accepted results independently challenged; current #sets flaw prevents global owner-root closure. Parent owns separate completeness/skeptic.

findings.title: Retained secret owners still lack a complete ending lifetime
findings.classificationNote: Continues original broad owner finding: a newly confirmed exceptional-path variant, not a new duplicate SEC ID. Earlier producer/native corrections remain credited at their exact snapshots.
findings.reproduction: Run restore-owner-probes.mjs. Actual ShareRestore.read result is transparently observed; a host shares-limit accessor throws after marked assessment, using real Node share platform/public vector. Independently reviewed renderer paths: run card-owner-probes.mjs (planning only, real renderer), and terminal-owner-probes.mjs (real TypedAnswer/hints, only terminal writer substituted).
findings.expected: The host error propagates and the internally owned marked plan is wiped when restore ends, including failures between read and search.
findings.observed: Failure propagates, but subsequent search on the real captured plan still succeeds. The healthy restore disposes the same kind of plan and its control passes. Three card-plan cases fail because ShareCardSet and EncodeCardExport lack wipe/dispose APIs and retain immutable decoded values. A throwing terminal hint-clear writer also skips answer byte erasure; healthy writer clears it. First card attempt had one incorrect # fixture expectation, corrected before the three intended failures were admitted. Static review also confirms raw typed-ahead/replay queues retain secret bytes in number arrays despite TS-07; existing consumed-byte zeroing is credited. Two actual artwork probes confirm recoloured RGBA scratch is not wiped on successful PNG encoding or an encoder exception.
findings.impact: Owned marked-share plans, retained card values, answer/replay bytes and derived artwork scratch do not consistently end their lifetime. Static queue representation violates TS-07. No external disclosure, heap exploit, denial of service or guaranteed recoverability is demonstrated.
findings.recommendedFix: Give #sets an enclosing finally releasing its read plan; keep independent returned set projections and idempotent search cleanup. Give retained card values one shared byte owner, end ShareCardSet and EncodeCardExport lifetimes after awaited work, retain independent conversions and borrowed inputs, and put answer/read-again erasure in finally beyond terminal-output failures. Replace raw number-array queues with byte-owned segmented storage preserving paste/UTF-8/cancel behavior. Wipe recoloured RGBA scratch in finally while preserving returned PNG bytes and public cached photographs.
